title: Information-Theoretic Causal Modelling of Semiconductor Process Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2608.14678v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the progress of the semiconductor industry toward increasingly complex compute devices and tighter process tolerances, advanced process control has become crucial. This work explores a novel framework to infer the underlying dynamics of semiconductor processes, directly from raw equipment log-file time-series data. By modelling the tool dynamics as a stochastic dynamical system comprising (a) a deterministic component and (b) a stochastic component, we estimate entropy transfer rates between variables through the Liang-Kleeman and Pires formalism. Preliminary results indicated that 7.5% of the inferred dependencies were known, 36.0% were plausible, 17.5% represented previously uncharacterised relationships, and 39.0% were inconsistent with established process knowledge. These findings demonstrate the framework's capability to uncover novel causal insights, while motivating further improvements to reduce inconsistent findings.

translated_title: 信息论视角下的半导体工艺动力学因果建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14678v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：随着半导体行业向日益复杂的计算设备和更严格的工艺公差发展，先进过程控制变得至关重要。本研究探索了一种新颖框架，直接从原始设备日志文件时间序列数据中推断半导体工艺的潜在动力学。通过将工具动力学建模为包含（a）确定性成分和（b）随机成分的随机动力系统，我们利用Liang-Kleeman和Pires形式估计变量之间的熵转移率。初步结果显示，推断出的依赖关系中7.5%为已知，36.0%为合理，17.5%代表先前未表征的关系，39.0%与既有工艺知识不一致。这些发现证明了该框架在揭示新颖因果洞察方面的能力，同时激励进一步改进以减少不一致结果。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于信息论和随机动力系统建模的新框架，从设备日志数据中推断半导体工艺的因果依赖关系，能够发现新颖的因果联系，但需优化以减少不一致结果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel framework based on information theory and stochastic dynamical system modeling to infer causal dependencies in semiconductor processes from equipment log data, uncovering novel causal insights while requiring refinement to reduce inconsistencies.
